description: Hierarchical screen registry. Reference any screen as Module>section>SCR-CODE-NN (e.g. Rider>onboarding-screens>SCR-ONB-01). All screens are connected to api-nest + Firebase except the onboarding intros (SCR-ONB-01..03).

SCR-ONB-01.title: Splash Screen
SCR-ONB-01.description: Logo splash with live pill and validation progress; auto-advances to SCR-ONB-02 after 3s

SCR-ONB-02.title: Onboarding #1 — Meet While You Move
SCR-ONB-02.description: Hero card (9-seat rolling rooms) with Verify Your Ride & Join CTA

SCR-ONB-03.title: Onboarding #2 — Verified Rides Only
SCR-ONB-03.description: Trip Validation Engine explainer, feature tiles, riders-now card, pager dots

SCR-ONB-04.title: Authentication
SCR-ONB-04.description: Step 1/4 (dynamic): Firebase phone OTP (country picker, SMS send via reCAPTCHA, 6-digit code with autofill, resend cooldown) → POST /v1/auth/bootstrap → SCR-ONB-05, or SCR-ONB-06 when the profile is already complete

SCR-ONB-05.title: Profile Setup
SCR-ONB-05.description: Step 2/4 (dynamic): GET /v1/auth/me prefill; display name / home city / ride style / incognito form (react-hook-form + zod); avatar upload via POST /v1/auth/me/photo-upload signed URL; save with PATCH /v1/auth/me

SCR-ONB-06.title: Rideshare Connect
SCR-ONB-06.description: Step 3/4: platform picker (Uber, Lyft, Grab, Ola, Bolt, Other) — platform-agnostic, no API linking

SCR-ONB-07.title: Permissions
SCR-ONB-07.description: Step 4/4 (dynamic): requests camera+mic, GPS (required) and motion/activity permissions; shows live status

room-screens.description: Trip validation and rolling video rooms (Sleek 8–13)

SCR-ROOM-01.title: Trip Validation
SCR-ROOM-01.description: Trip Validation (dynamic): live speed, 3-module checklist, score/state from the engine, share trip status, safety FAB, dev simulator

SCR-ROOM-02.title: Vibe Selection
SCR-ROOM-02.description: Vibe Selection (dynamic): live R.O.O.M. counts per vibe, recommended vibe from ride style, join (requires VERIFIED)

SCR-ROOM-03.title: Active Room
SCR-ROOM-03.description: Active R.O.O.M. (dynamic): LiveKit 3x3 video, translated chat overlay, grace countdown, Next, mic/cam, report, hang up

SCR-ROOM-04.title: Disconnect Summary
SCR-ROOM-04.description: Ride Summary (dynamic): duration, distance, peers met, grace stats, end reason, rating, report

SCR-ROOM-05.title: Traffic Grace Period
SCR-ROOM-05.description: Traffic Grace (dynamic): opens on GRACE in a room, live 5-minute countdown, Stay / Exit, closes on recovery

SCR-ROOM-06.title: Fast-Track Matchmaking
SCR-ROOM-06.description: Fast-Track (dynamic): POST /v1/rooms/next — blocks previous riders 60 min and seats the rider in another R.O.O.M.

SCR-ACC-01.title: Connections & History
SCR-ACC-01.description: Connections & History: real validated-ride history and totals (peer requests coming soon)

SCR-ACC-02.title: Settings & Trust Center
SCR-ACC-02.description: Settings & Trust Center (dynamic): profile, language/safety links, privacy shields, logout

SCR-ACC-03.title: Language & Translation
SCR-ACC-03.description: Native language, auto-translate toggle, subtitle size and style (GET/PUT /v1/me/preferences)

SCR-ACC-04.title: Safety & Trusted Contacts
SCR-ACC-04.description: Trusted contacts (SMS/WhatsApp/email, picker from phone contacts) and "offer to share when VERIFIED"
